headline: President Lai: Actively Promoting New Ten Major AI Projects to Build an AI Island | Politics
summary: President Lai Ching-te said the government is promoting the New Ten Major AI Projects. The goal is to train at least 500,000 AI application talents before 2040 and help SMEs accelerate upgrading.
why: Government industrial policy can direct public spending and support toward strategic sectors such as AI. Programs for small and medium-sized enterprises affect Taiwan's broader business adoption of technology.
